commands.name: match-paper-title
commands.summary: Find the single paper that best matches a given title (returns 404 if there is no good match)

commands.name: get-paper-citations
commands.summary: List the papers that cite a given paper (citing papers, with context/intents)

commands.name: get-paper-references
commands.summary: List the papers a given paper cites (its bibliography)

commands.name: get-paper-recommendations
commands.summary: Recommend papers similar to a given paper

commands.name: get-author
commands.summary: Get an author profile: name, affiliations, homepage, paper count, citation count, h-index

commands.name: list-author-papers
commands.summary: List the papers written by an author

commands.name: autocomplete-papers
commands.summary: Title and query suggestions for partial text, as shown in the semanticscholar.org search box
